name: Drowned Sorrows
summary: At Faldir's Cove, Captain Steelgut mourns the Maiden's Folly and asks you to kill the Daggerspine naga who slew the wreck's survivors.

sections.title: A Captain by the Fire
sections.body: At Faldir's Cove, Captain Steelgut sits by the fire and wishes the sea had taken him too. His crew fought hard to save the Maiden's Folly, but water rushed in all at once and the ship sank. O'Breen reached shore safely, while the naga killed the other survivors. Steelgut wants ten Daggerspine raiders and three Daggerspine sorceresses dead.

faq.answer: Captain Steelgut commanded the Maiden's Folly. After the ship was lost, he sat by a fire at Faldir's Cove.

faq.q: What happened to the Maiden's Folly?
faq.answer: Steelgut says the sea sank the Maiden's Folly. The ship was afloat, then water rushed in all at once despite the crew's hard fight to save it.

faq.q: Why does Captain Steelgut want the naga killed?
faq.answer: The naga killed the wreck's survivors, and Steelgut wants them dead.

faq.q: Which naga does Steelgut want dead?
faq.answer: Ten Daggerspine raiders and three Daggerspine sorceresses, as Steelgut asks.
